description: Fetch metrics for one specific Featured App by its app_id (contract id from the Scan API). Returns name, category, TVL, 24h volume, user count, and last activity from the Featured Apps registry. Canton-specific. TVL / volume / users may be null when only the Scan API source is available.

app_id.description: Featured-app contract id, or a unique prefix of it as shown by list_featured_apps.

name: get_app_metrics
